design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used a single plausible value for the dependent variable, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study does not mention whether sampling weights were applied, leaving it unclear if they were used.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study appears to use student-level models without accounting for school clustering, as it focuses on a selected sample of students.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods such as train/test splits, indicating that it did not validate findings on an external dataset.
